column2: National Library Board Library Reach Index, Collections And Loans, Annual

column4: Includes partner libraries.  Partner libraries are libraries that are fully funded by partners, and operated by NLB/NLB's subsidiary.

Refers to the proportion of unique Singapore residents who have visited NATIONAL LIBRARY BOARD (NLB)'s libraries and archives and/or accessed NLB's content through NLB's programmes, exhibitions and services within a 12-month period.  The 2020 Reach Index has been adjusted from 68.3 to 70.9.  This is due to a change in weighting factors applied to 2020 data, in order to align categories for highest attained education level with Singapore Standard Educational Classification (SSEC) 2020.

Includes books, serials and special materials (namely, Art Print, Compact disc, Compact disc interactive, Computer File, CD-ROMs, DVD, VCD, Filmstrip, Kit, Map, Microfiche, Microfilm, Music score, Recorded disc, Talking books, Tape recording, Tape slide, Videocassette, Videodisc and Laserdisc, braille, game, motion picture, wall chart, picture collection, ephemera and manuscript).

Refers to the total number of eBook copies made available on NLB's e-resource platforms such as Apabi, Overdrive and Tumblebooks, World eBook Library Database (WeL) etc. With effect from August 2017, subscription to WeL was discontinued.

Includes loans of physical books, magazines and AV materials (such as Video Tapes, VCDs, CDs, CD-ROMs, DVDs and music scores).  Data from 2004 include materials borrowed from public libraries only.  Prior to 2004 data include materials borrowed from public, government and academic libraries.  Five libraries were closed for revamp in 2017.  During the Circuit Breaker period in Singapore, all libraries and archives were closed to the public from 7 April 2020 to 30 June 2020.  While NLB reopened its sites from 1 July 2020, capacity numbers had to be kept limited and controlled.  Hence, this resulted in lower figures for physical loans as compared to 2019.
Prior to 2017, the data was for eBook usage.  With effect from 2017, the data also included the usage for eMagazines and eNewspapers.
Refers to physical visits to National Library Board's libraries and archives.
